cards.front: PMMA , or bone cement , has a Young’s modulus between cortical and cancellous bone.
cards.extra: *PMMA, or bone cement, is frequently used in joint replacement surgery, tumor surgery, and spine surgery. Bone cements are provided as two-component materials, a powder and a liquid. The powder usually contains a polymer, benzoyl peroxide (initiator), and barium sulfate (radio-opacifier). The liquid usually contains a monomer, DMPT (accelerator), and hydroquinone (stabilizer). The two components are mixed and a free radical polymerization occurs when the initiator is mixed with the accelerator.
